report_scope: Source-attributed n25 test reports with individual acceptance findings; mathematical answer data withheld.

phases.activity_zh: 公开候选、方法检索及全闭盘上界
phases.activity_en: Public candidate and method research; full closed-disk upper bound
phases.outcome_zh: 候选来自公开资料；完成32个三角形和8个完整二维圆弧帽的解析覆盖。
phases.outcome_en: The candidate came from public sources; analytic coverage was established for 32 triangles and eight complete two-dimensional circular caps.

phases.activity_zh: 一般覆盖归约、枚举和精确证书方法
phases.activity_en: Reduction of arbitrary covers, enumeration and exact certificate methods
phases.outcome_zh: 推广公开 n20 的一般方法及实验代码；完成必要几何归约、力流证书和局部应力证明，早期部分枚举尚不是最终证明。
phases.outcome_en: Extend public n20 methods and experimental code; establish necessary geometric reductions, force certificates and a local stress proof. Early partial enumeration was not the final proof.

phases.activity_zh: 八内盘引理及完整 n25 目录和证书生成
phases.activity_en: Eight-interior-disk lemma, complete n25 catalogue and certificate generation
phases.outcome_zh: 补充八内盘七辐轮必要条件；重写最终枚举，完成十类4,568,172图和7,136前沿任务，未完成项为零。
phases.outcome_en: Add the necessary seven-spoke-wheel condition for eight interior disks; reimplement final enumeration and complete ten classes, 4,568,172 graphs and 7,136 frontier tasks, with zero unfinished items.

phases.activity_zh: 重新枚举及全量严格证书校验
phases.activity_en: Fresh enumeration and full exact certificate verification
phases.outcome_zh: 重新枚举逐类一致；检查全部连续角度域的完整树、每叶严格不等式和局部定理。
phases.outcome_en: Fresh enumeration matched every class; complete trees covering the continuous angle domains, every strict leaf inequality and the local theorem were checked.

phases.activity_zh: 证明说明、冻结交付和逐文件回读
phases.activity_en: Proof documentation, frozen delivery and file-by-file readback
phases.outcome_zh: 完整证明、源码及证书包完成，逐文件SHA-256/长度核对后Goal完成。
phases.outcome_en: The full proof, source and certificate package were delivered; Goal completed after SHA-256 and size readback checks.

reused_materials: n20 experimental peeling code adapted during exploration
external_work.contribution_zh: 本次补足n25全闭盘覆盖、八内盘必要条件、最终完整目录、局部应力论证及全角度域严格证书；最终枚举和验证交付与早期改编的公开实验代码有别。
external_work.contribution_en: Supply n25 full-disk coverage, the necessary eight-interior-disk condition, the final exhaustive catalogue, local stress argument and exact full-angle-domain certificates; final enumeration and verification differ from the early adapted public experimental code.
external_work.verification_scope: original complete runs plus publisher post-test review using pre-existing research assets, a fresh catalogue and full exact replay

verification.scope: geometric completeness arguments and exact mathematical inequalities; program success and fingerprint equality alone are not proof

reference_status_correction.note: The global optimality proofs for n=25 and n=26 were accepted by the project’s local mathematical review on 2026-09-26. Independent review of the n=26 minimal-polynomial source remains pending; this is separate from global optimality. Fingerprint matching compares answer data and does not verify a submitted proof.
reference_status_correction.retained_scope: Original test observations, failed score and historical reference_status fields are preserved.
